llc.formation_notes: Fees are set by Secretary of State rule (MCA 35-8-211); sosmt.gov and rules.mt.gov block automated reading. Third-party guides cite $35 to form - not verified.

annual_report.name: Annual Report
annual_report.due: between January 1 and April 15, starting the year after organization

sources.title: MCA 35-8-208 Annual report
sources.quote: The first annual report must be delivered to the secretary of state between January 1 and April 15 of the year following the calendar year in which a domestic limited liability company is organized

sources.title: MCA 35-8-211 Fees
sources.quote: The secretary of state shall establish fees for the following

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Electing pass-through entity pays the highest marginal individual rate (5.65% for 2026) on owners' distributive share of Montana-source income (MCA 15-30-3326, enacted 2023).

sources.title: MCA 15-30-3326 Pass-through entity tax
sources.quote: The entity tax is equal to the highest marginal tax rate in effect under 15-30-2103 for the tax year the election is made multiplied by the distributive share

personal_exemption.notes: Montana taxable income starts from federal taxable income (federal standard/itemized deduction already applied); no separate Montana standard deduction or exemption. HOH bracket $71,250. Net long-term capital gains taxed at 3.0% / 4.1%.

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: None. Scheduled for 2027: 4.7% to $65,000 single / $130,000 MFJ, 5.4% above, then indexed.

sources.title: MCA 15-30-2103 (Temporary, terminates Dec 31, 2026) Rate of tax
sources.quote: on the first $47,500 of Montana taxable income or any part of that income, 4.7%; on any Montana taxable income in excess of $47,500 ... 5.65%

sources.title: MCA 15-30-2103 joint filers
sources.quote: on the first $95,000 of Montana taxable income or any part of that income, 4.7%

sources.title: MCA 15-30-2101 definitions
sources.quote: "Montana taxable income" means federal taxable income as determined for federal income tax purposes and adjusted as provided in 15-30-2120.

estimated_tax.required_if: expect to owe more than $500 in tax

unemployment_2026.notes: New employers pay their industry average rate: 1.00% for most industries (services 1.10%, agriculture/mining 1.30%, construction 2.00%), plus 0.18% Administrative Fund Tax.

notable: 2026 brackets widened by HB 337 (2025): 4.7% up to $47,500 single / $95,000 joint, 5.65% above (https://archive.legmt.gov/bills/mca/title_0150/chapter_0300/part_0210/section_0030/0150-0300-0210-0030.html)

Montana tax starts from federal taxable income, so the federal standard deduction flows through (https://archive.legmt.gov/bills/mca/title_0150/chapter_0300/part_0210/section_0010/0150-0300-0210-0010.html)
No sales tax and no local income taxes.
